name: The Workshop
hint: Crates, blocks, switches, lifts: clock in and build your way out.
why4: The 4-block that becomes the stairs and the roof lift both need all four, and the roof bridge only exists while two hold a plate on each side in turn.
solution: Stage A: P1 stands against the shelf at x=5; P2 jumps off P1's head onto it (height 3), grabs the crate at x=2, walks off and drops it on the plate at x=14-15. P1 boosts P2 again for the crate at x=1. Plate 2/2: gate A at x=20 opens for good.

Stage B: P4 hops the 4-block, stands against gate E at x=30 and jumps into the switch above it (x=31, 3-4 high): E opens, F (x=40) closes. P4 hops back onto the block and drops in at the front of the line.
Conga-push the 4-block (x=26-27) right: P4 against it, P3, P2, P1 behind, through E until it rests against F (block at x=38-39).
P1 stands at x=32 and jumps into the switch from the right: E closes, F opens.

Key: P4 jumps onto P3's head under the one-way shelf at x=35-37 and jumps up through it, touching the key at x=36; P4 walks back over the others' heads to the end of the line. Conga-push the block on until it stops against the mezzanine wall (block at x=46-47).

Stage C: everyone climbs floor -> block top (2) -> mezzanine (2 more), and all four stand on the lift at x=56-59 (4/4); it rises 7 tiles to the roof. All four jump off together (with fewer than four aboard it slides back down).
Stage D: P1 and P4 stand on the near plate at x=63-64: bridge H over the 6-wide gap (x=68-73) appears. P3 and P2 cross and stand on the far plate at x=77-78; P1 and P4 cross.
P3 and P2 walk on past the door; P4 hops P1, opens the door at x=86; all press Down.

Recovery: the switch can be flipped back from either side; anyone who falls through the gap respawns at the start and comes back over the stairs, but the lift needs all four, so the others ride down (step off: it slides back) and up again with them.
